method: Post-two-review menu-only correctness check; no third ordinary review or rescore. Normal URL, real DOM bounds and click at three desktop sizes.

rows.text: OPERATOR HANDBOOK×MOVE WITH PURPOSE.The Custodian arms after the third memory. Destroy its three copper coils: armored shutters take chip damage; after each volley they lift for critical hits. Amber lanes lock before firing: move behind cover. Shift close to a charging coil cancels the volley and opens shutters for 3 seconds.Extraction uploads only while standing inside the marked uplink deck. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay.Engineering has two single-use amber capacitor banks. Shoot the cabinet or isolator: a 1.1-second warning precedes a 6 m discharge. Move clear, use solid cover or phase protection. The spent cabinet remains cover. Enemy fire cannot trigger it.W A S D MoveMOUSE LookLMB Fire coil rifleRMB Aim down sightsR ReloadSHIFT Soul Shift / dashCTRL SprintSPACE JumpHOLD E Recover nearby memoryM Facility map · mission pausedESC Pause / release mouseSoul Shift protects briefly. Dash within 4.5 m of a charging enemy to cancel its shot and stagger it for 0.8 s. A blue emitter flash confirms the break. Dashing toward a charge stops early on a successful break so you can follow up. Sideways dodges retain full travel. It deals no damage; the 4.5 s cooldown still applies. Your shield regenerates when you avoid damage.THREAT VISOR · Orange ! means a charging threat. Muted chevrons show recent fire or hits. A number counts nearby sources in that direction; one source has no number. Offscreen cues use broad direction sectors, not exact positions. Optic brackets stay beside visible emitters. The lower readout follows one target near aim. Cues require clear optic sight and expire.UNDERSTOOD ↗
